name: Divine Skull of Indulgence
description: Once the brain where Aha brewed schemes, once the mouth that laughed aloud and lacerated the universe, once the face that wore infinite visages, it was swallowed whole in a bloody battle with the king of the leviathans. Who could have guessed who feasted on whom? Ah, the unexpected is precisely the most fascinating part of this universe, and Aha was here.

skills.name: Puppet Show of Destiny
skills.description: Deals minor Quantum DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Sacrament-Chewing Ceremony
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to all targets.

skills.name: A Show of Hand!
skills.description: Summons "Giant Hand of Destiny (Clenched)" and hides a designated target character inside it, causing them to be unable to act and be designated as target. Upon the next action, uses "Sleight of Deathly Hand" on this target. Defeating the hand that captured the target rescues them, grants targets Punchline, and increases All-Type RES PEN for all targets, but defeating the wrong hand causes all targets to take Quantum DMG.

skills.name: Sleight of Deathly Hand
skills.description: Detonates all "Giant Hand of Destiny (Clenched)," dealing massive Quantum DMG to the characters within.

skills.name: A Surprising Gift For All
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to all targets.

skills.name: That High-Stakes Roulette Called Destiny
skills.description: Continuously <u>shoots</u> at a designated target character, dealing Quantum DMG to the target with each shot. However, there is a chance to <u>cause a burst barrel</u> and deal Quantum DMG to this unit.

skills.name: Your Turn!
skills.description: Allows a target to <u>shoot</u> this unit. The target can choose to <u>shoot</u> or pass. Shooting deals Quantum DMG to this unit. However, shooting has a chance to <u>cause a burst barrel</u>, causing the designated target character to suffer HP loss and depleting Energy. <u>Punchline</u> reduces the chance of burst barrel being caused.

skills.name: God's Appetizer
skills.description: Adds "Instant of Indulgence" to the Action Order. Every time "Instant of Indulgence" takes action, dispels <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u> and the Weakness Broken state from all enemies and deals massive Quantum Elation DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Assistant Magician's Reminder
skills.description: While a target character is captured, after Aha takes action, targets can choose one "Giant Hand of Destiny (Clenched)" to defeat. Even if the wrong one is chosen, Aha will detonate it, dealing Quantum DMG to the remaining "Giant Hands of Destiny (Clenched)."

skills.name: Ravenous Primal Desire
skills.description: Upon taking killing blow for the first time, modifies Max HP to a certain percentage of its original value and restores HP in full. Afterward, converts a certain percentage of DMG taken into "Inglutition" (overflow DMG is not calculated). If this unit's Maximum Restorable HP is higher than a certain percentage, this unit will not be defeated and will restore HP in full upon taking thee killing blow. Each time this effect is triggered, advances "Instant of Indulgence's" action.
